query: INSERT INTO photos(id,short_id,album_id,title,original_hash,original_name,original_bytes,mime,kind,sort_order) SELECT ids.id,shorts.short_id,CASE WHEN ids.position<=50 THEN $3::uuid ELSE $4::uuid END,'Photo',$5,'photo.jpg',1,'image/jpeg','image',ids.position::integer FROM unnest($1::uuid[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS ids(id,position) JOIN unnest($2::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS shorts(short_id,position) USING(position)
